title: Technical explanations in simple English
intro: In technical rounds, explain what you built and why: simple words first, then the details.
introNative: Technical round-இல், என்ன உருவாக்கினீர்கள், ஏன் என்று முதலில் எளிய சொற்களில், பிறகு விவரமாகச் சொல்லுங்கள்.

phrases.text: In simple terms, this service checks every payment for fraud before it's approved.
phrases.native: எளிமையாகச் சொன்னால், ஒவ்வொரு payment-ஐயும் approve ஆவதற்கு முன் இந்த service fraud இருக்கிறதா என்று சோதிக்கிறது.
phrases.note: Give the one-line purpose first, then the details.

phrases.text: We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.
phrases.native: ஒரு நாளைக்குச் சுமார் பத்து லட்சம் events-ஐ process செய்ய வேண்டியிருந்ததால் Kafka-வைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தோம்.
phrases.note: Always pair a choice with a reason: "We chose X because…"

phrases.text: The trade-off was more complexity, but we got much better scalability.
phrases.native: Complexity கொஞ்சம் அதிகமானது, ஆனால் scalability நன்றாக மேம்பட்டது; அதுதான் trade-off.

phrases.text: Let me walk you through the architecture step by step.
phrases.note: "Walk you through" means explain something in order.

phrases.text: We split the monolith into five Spring Boot microservices.
phrases.native: Monolith-ஐ ஐந்து Spring Boot microservices-ஆகப் பிரித்தோம்.
phrases.note: Concrete numbers and names make you sound confident.

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks: "Why did you use Kafka?" Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: Interviewer "ஏன் Kafka பயன்படுத்தினீர்கள்?" என்று கேட்கிறார். எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: Kafka is the best, everybody is using it.
Our architect told us to use Kafka.
We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.
steps.answer: We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.
steps.explanation: Give a technical reason linked to your project's needs.
steps.explanationNative: உங்கள் project தேவையுடன் தொடர்புடைய technical காரணத்தைச் சொல்லுங்கள்.

steps.promptNative: Monolith-ஐ ஐந்து Spring Boot microservices-ஆகப் பிரித்தோம்.
steps.answer: We split the monolith into five Spring Boot microservices.

steps.audioText: The trade-off was more complexity, but we got much better scalability.
options: The trade-off was more complexity, but we got much better stability.
The trade-off was more complexity, but we got much better scalability.
The trade-off was less complexity, but we lost some scalability.
steps.answer: The trade-off was more complexity, but we got much better scalability.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: We splitted the application into microservices.
options: We splitted the application into microservices.
We split the application into microservices.
We have splitted the application into microservices.
We were splitting the application to microservices.
steps.answer: We split the application into microservices.
steps.explanation: "Split" is irregular: its past tense is also "split", never "splitted".
steps.explanationNative: "Split" என்பதன் past tense-உம் "split" தான்; "splitted" என்ற சொல்லே இல்லை.

steps.prompt: The interviewer asks you to explain your system's design. How do you begin? Which answer is best?
steps.promptNative: உங்கள் system design-ஐ விளக்கச் சொல்கிறார். எப்படித் தொடங்குவீர்கள்? எந்த பதில் சிறந்தது?
options: It is very complex, difficult to explain.
Let me walk you through the architecture step by step.
Architecture is there, microservices are there, database is there.
steps.answer: Let me walk you through the architecture step by step.
steps.explanation: Offer a clear, ordered explanation; it shows you understand the system.
steps.explanationNative: படிப்படியாக, ஒழுங்காக விளக்குவதாகச் சொல்லுங்கள். System உங்களுக்கு நன்றாகப் புரிந்திருக்கிறது என்று அது காட்டும்.

steps.prompt: Which is the correct way to say this?
steps.wrong: I am not aware about this tool.
options: I am not aware about this tool.
I'm not familiar with this tool.
I am not aware of about this tool.
I am not knowing about this tool.
steps.answer: I'm not familiar with this tool.
steps.explanation: "Aware about" is incorrect; "I'm not familiar with" is the natural way to say it.
steps.explanationNative: "Aware about" தவறு. "I'm not familiar with this tool" என்று சொல்வது இயல்பாக இருக்கும்.

steps.promptNative: எளிமையாகச் சொன்னால், ஒவ்வொரு payment-ஐயும் approve ஆவதற்கு முன் இந்த service fraud இருக்கிறதா என்று சோதிக்கிறது.
steps.answer: In simple terms, this service checks every payment for fraud before it's approved.

steps.audioText: We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.
options: We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a billion events a day.
We used Kafka because we wanted to process about a million events a week.
We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.
steps.answer: We chose Kafka because we needed to process about a million events a day.

steps.prompt: Explain one real system you've worked on, out loud, in 3–4 sentences: what it does in simple terms, one technology choice and why, and the trade-off.
steps.promptNative: நீங்கள் வேலை செய்த ஒரு உண்மையான system-ஐ 3–4 வாக்கியங்களில் சத்தமாக விளக்குங்கள்: எளிமையாக அது என்ன செய்கிறது, ஒரு technology தேர்வும் அதன் காரணமும், trade-off.
